title: Robert Robotti  - From Pink Sheets to Portfolio Management: Bob Robotti's Value Investing Journey
summary:
He breaks
down key investments, including Builders FirstSource and Tidewater,
and explains why capital allocation, aligned incentives, and
patience are critical to long-term success. With deep roots in accounting and formative experiences
auditing firms like Tweedy, Browne, Bob shares how those early
exposures led him to a career buying underfollowed, undervalued
companies. In this episode, Bob discusses how his contrarian
approach has thrived amid market inefficiencies, especially in
cyclical industries and under-the-radar public firms.
